reconstructed_captions.22: The man places the stone axe head against the base of a tree to begin chopping.
reconstructed_captions.23: He strikes the back of the axe head with a wooden mallet, driving it into the tree.
reconstructed_captions.24: He continues to hammer the axe head into the tree trunk with the wooden mallet.
reconstructed_captions.25: He strikes the axe head repeatedly, creating a deep notch in the tree.
reconstructed_captions.26: Wood chips fly as he continues to hammer the stone axe into the tree.
reconstructed_captions.27: He drives the axe head deep into the wood with another powerful strike of the mallet.
